purpose: Document issues that may be addressed in future sessions without remediating them now

items.description: EW_A text describes budgetary slack (P1-BC-095 topic) instead of explaining why standard costing is wrong for a sensitivity (what-if) analysis question. Text: 'A department consistently beating its budget by a wide margin suggests budget targets are set too low...'
items.learner_pool_impact: Medium — learners selecting Choice A on this Certified item see feedback about an unrelated topic
items.certification_blocking: No per current rules (G-NEW-2 applies but was added S508)
items.deferral_reason: Not in S710 scope (targeted Certified DL-026 uplift only). Remediating EW_A would modify a non-target field with text already present. Requires careful rewrite to match item's actual topic.

items.description: EW_A describes why an investment center is wrong (matching Choice D's text), and EW_D describes why a cost center is wrong (matching Choice A's text). The texts are substantively correct but attributed to the wrong choice letters.
items.learner_pool_impact: Medium — learners selecting Choice A see feedback about Choice D and vice versa
items.certification_blocking: No per current rules, but pedagogically confusing
items.deferral_reason: Not in S710 scope. Requires swapping two EW fields and possibly revising lead-in text to reference the correct choice.

items.issue_type: DL-031 Difficulty recalibration — systematic difficulty inflation
items.description: Estimated ~500 items across all 5 packs labeled Moderate (3) that test Bloom's Remember/Understand level. Pattern: Stem is a textbook definition, answer is the defined term. Should be Easy (1).
items.learner_pool_impact: Low — difficulty labels affect session composition but not content correctness
items.recommended_future_session: S712 — DL-031/DL-032 difficulty recalibration (after freeze confirmed)
items.deferral_reason: Non-blocking. 2,181 items are pedagogically sound. Difficulty labels are cosmetic metadata improvements.

items.issue_type: DL-032 Case bank uniform difficulty — zero variance
items.description: All 420 case items across 75 cases labeled Moderate with no differentiation. Statistically implausible. CAQS §6.1 targets Easy 15%, Moderate-Easy 20%, Moderate 30%, Difficult 25%, Very Difficult 10%.
items.learner_pool_impact: Low — difficulty labels affect session composition
items.deferral_reason: Non-blocking. Same class as ISSUE-003. Case bank content is correct; difficulty labels need calibration.

items.issue_type: Non-Certified DL-026 pool — 299 items with empty distractor slots
items.description: 299 non-Certified items (Archived/Unprocessed) have at least one empty non-CC ExplanationWrong slot. Outside the learner pool — not urgent.
items.learner_pool_impact: None — all non-Certified items excluded from delivery
items.certification_blocking: Yes — blocks certification of these items if promoted
items.recommended_future_session: Future certification preparation wave before promoting Unprocessed→Certified
items.deferral_reason: Not in learner pool. Should be addressed when these items enter the certification pipeline.

summary: 5 optional issues documented. None are certification-blocking for the current learner pool. ISSUE-001 and ISSUE-002 are the most impactful (both affect Certified items with wrong-topic or swapped feedback). ISSUE-003 and ISSUE-004 are cosmetic difficulty calibrations. ISSUE-005 is a pre-certification preparation task.
